description: Price any options trade with up to eight legs: maximum profit and loss, breakevens, net credit or debit, the model's chance of profit at expiration and the expected move. Pass a strategy name (for example iron_condor or bull_put_spread) to build standard legs from the stock price, or pass the legs yourself with strikes and prices. Ask it for the max loss on a spread, the breakeven on a straddle, or the chance a condor finishes profitable. Returns a link that opens the same trade in the Optionscanner calculator.

days.description: This leg's own days to expiration, when it differs from the trade's.
days.title: Days

iv_pct.description: This leg's own implied volatility in percent, when it differs from the trade's.
iv_pct.title: Iv Pct

premium.description: Price per share at entry. Estimated from volatility when omitted.
premium.title: Premium

qty.description: Contracts for an option leg, shares for a stock leg.
qty.title: Qty

strike.description: Strike price in dollars. Required for a call or put.
strike.title: Strike

iv_pct.description: Implied volatility, percent per year (30 means 30 percent).
iv_pct.title: Iv Pct

legs.description: The legs of the trade, up to eight. Each has a side (buy or sell), a type (call, put or stock), a strike for options, a quantity, and optionally the price per share paid or received; a missing price is estimated from the implied volatility.
legs.title: Legs

rate_pct.description: Interest rate the model uses, percent per year. Default 4.
rate_pct.title: Rate Pct

strategy.description: A standard structure built from the stock price: long_call, long_put, covered_call, cash_secured_put, bull_call_spread, bear_put_spread, bull_put_spread, bear_call_spread, iron_condor, long_straddle, long_strangle. Omit when passing legs.
strategy.title: Strategy
